intent: Every time a policy rule stepped in on an agent by itself: blocked, rewritten or flagged, what the agent tried, newest first. A row opens a Drawer with the exact attempt, the rule and its owner, and a confirmed override request.
useWhen: showing guardrails at work: rules that stopped, changed or flagged agent actions without being asked
a person needs to see exactly what an agent tried and ask the rule's owner for an exception
a header needs a one-line count of rule hits (compact)
doNotUseWhen: the agent asks before acting — ApprovalCard
the agent asks for standing access — PermissionRequest
a general stream of events and changes — ActivityFeed

events.note: Newest first. { id, verdict: "blocked" | "rewritten" | "flagged", rule: { name, text, owner }, agent: { name, src? }, attempted, sentInstead?, at, runHref? }[]. sentInstead shows for rewritten.

filters.note: { verdict?, rule?, agent?, time? }. Uncontrolled when omitted. Verdict, rule and agent filter the list; time is a label, so pass the events in that window.

selectedId.note: The event open in the Drawer; null closes it. Uncontrolled when omitted.

onRequestOverride.note: (id, reason) => void, after the AlertDialog confirms. Submit request is the Drawer's one solid primary; omit to hide the request.

overrideStatus.note: sending disables Submit; sent shows a success Alert; error a danger Alert, keeping the reason.

compact.note: One line: the summary ("14 blocked · 3 rewritten · 6 flagged this week") plus the latest event.

requirements: verdicts are words in a Badge, never colour alone
rows are buttons in a list; Up and Down move between them; the open row has aria-current
filters are a kit FilterBar; a filter opens a labelled RadioGroup of its values
the Drawer and AlertDialog keep focus; closing the Drawer returns focus to its row
the override reason is a labelled Textarea; Submit confirms in a kit AlertDialog

doNot: Do not invent a local PolicyLog, RuleHitList or OverrideForm
Do not use it for questions the agent asks first (ApprovalCard, PermissionRequest)
Submit request is the one solid primary, in the Drawer
snippet: <GuardrailLog events={[{ id: "e1", verdict: "blocked", rule: { name: "No refunds over €500", text: "Refunds above €500 need a finance lead.", owner: "Finance ops" }, agent: { name: "Billing agent" }, attempted: "refund(order=48213, amount=740)", at: "14:02" }]} onRequestOverride={request} />
